sources.title: Race evidence
sources.description: Server tickets, submitted results, terminal verification outcomes and pinned contracts.

sources.title: Immutable track versions
sources.description: Stored version identity, content hash, car and rules; published content remains immutable.

sources.title: Player support
sources.description: Account state, purchases, entitlements, resumes and submitted-race history; no client play-session timeline.

sources.title: Race evidence bundle
sources.description: Checksummed JSON snapshot of redacted server records; no full replay, client diagnostics or expiring hosted bundle.

sources.title: Verification health
sources.description: Current worker compatibility, queue age, recent server outcomes and configured backup marker.

sources.title: Operational counts
sources.description: Registered accounts and received submissions by UTC window; these are not foreground activity or retention.

sources.title: Behaviour and retention
sources.description: No versioned mobile-event ingestion, foreground sessions, ordered onboarding events or discovery exposures.

sources.title: Client quality
sources.description: No backend crash, ANR, build/device frame summaries or Play vitals feed.

sources.title: Verified provider commerce
sources.description: Development purchases exist; live Play verification, signed ad rewards, revenue and reconciliation feeds are not configured.

sources.title: Remote configuration and experiments
sources.description: Pinned race manifests exist; no mutable configuration registry, activation, exposure or rollback service.

sources.title: Individual staff identity
sources.description: Existing access uses separate owner/analyst credentials; individual staff SSO and MFA are not implemented.

limitations: Capabilities describe this application implementation, not a live check of external providers.
Stored submissions do not establish race starts, quits, foreground playtime or voluntary returns.
A backup marker does not establish a successful restore or a recovery-time guarantee.
This Studio inspection does not change game records or execute verification.
